result:
Perfect! The fix is complete. The issue was in the `PostResource.ts` file at line 20-34 where the `toArray()` method was missing the `excerpt` field. Even though the `PostResourceData` interface correctly defined `excerpt: string` (line 10), the implementation wasn't including it in the serialized response.

By adding `excerpt: post.excerpt as string,` to the returned object (line 26), the excerpt data is now properly serialized and sent to the frontend. This fixes all three issues:

- Post cards on the list will now display the excerpt under each title
- The post page will now show the excerpt between the byline and body
- The edit form will now be pre-populated with the excerpt

Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass successfully.
